tools.name: listEvents
tools.description: List upcoming published EventPass events with starting prices. Use this first to discover what's on.

tools.name: getEvent
tools.description: Get full details for one event: description, ticket types with prices, live availability, program, and food vendors. Use the slug from listEvents.

tools.description: Check-in stats for one event: how many tickets are issued, how many have checked in, how many have not, and how many were cancelled, with the same breakdown per ticket type. Use this on the day of the event to see who is still expected.

findings.detail: Description of "createOrder" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: getEvent, findTickets, get_sales_summary, get_attendee_list, get_pending_payments, get_checkin_stats, list_team_members · Private data: createOrder, get_attendee_list, get_pending_payments, confirm_pending_payment, deactivate_team_member · Public sink: findTickets, get_attendee_list, get_pending_payments, create_event, publish_event, confirm_pending_payment, send_broadcast, list_team_members, invite_team_member · Destructive: delete_draft_event, remove_team_member.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: getEvent, findTickets, get_sales_summary, get_attendee_list, get_pending_payments, get_checkin_stats, list_team_members · Private data: createOrder, get_attendee_list, get_pending_payments, confirm_pending_payment, deactivate_team_member · Public sink: findTickets, get_attendee_list, get_pending_payments, create_event, publish_event, confirm_pending_payment, send_broadcast, list_team_members, invite_team_member · Destructive: delete_draft_event, remove_team_member

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
